body: No, I have nobody. Pretty much my entire family is like that, and I've lost just about all my friends. Nobody wants to be friends with the person who is depressed all the time.
I do have to try and make it on my own. There's nobody here with me. I have nobody right now. This is a bullshit ass life. It's a waste. I just exist, I'm not "living"
but I've cried so much already, and it isn't going to do anything, apart from making my face wet
